blocks.text: All the services below are available at an additional cost. Choose an excursion for your free time; the day and time will be arranged around the main programme and the Carnival schedule.

blocks.text: Optional: private Botanical Garden tour with an English-speaking guide, minimum 2 people, USD 200 per person. See avenues of palms, orchids, pau-brasil and the giant water lilies of Frei Leandro Lake.

blocks.text: Optional: explore Rocinha by jeep. Join a group with an English-speaking guide for $90 per person, or book privately with an English-speaking guide for $170 per person, minimum 2 people. Return to the hotel after the trip.

blocks.text: Optional: $390 per person. Take off from Pedra Bonita in Tijuca Forest and land on Pepino Beach. An English-speaking instructor gives you a briefing, provides the equipment and flies with you; transfers and GoPro recording are included.
